entries.summary: Building an LLM-powered document-intelligence platform for a government client — end to end, from scanned PDFs to defensible scores.
bullets: OCR pipeline for scanned official journals: PyMuPDF page rendering + vision-model transcription, cached so no document is read twice.
Rubric-driven LLM scoring that quotes its evidence — every score carries the exact line in the source document it came from.
Built against an expert-rated reference set of 136 products. The pilot ran end to end on four; on the first, exact-match and within-one agreement with the experts was measured per parameter.
stack: OpenAI SDK against Gemini and OpenRouter models

entries.summary: Attacked face-recognition models to measure how they break — black-box adversarial ML at a defence research lab.
bullets: Engineered black-box adversarial attack pipelines (SimBA, NES) across 8+ models on 9,000+ samples.
Implemented transfer-based PGD attacks with norm constraints, using cosine similarity for evaluation.
Designed score-based query attacks that iterate on similarity feedback alone.
Evaluated model robustness with DeepFace embeddings and analyzed attack transferability across architectures.
